dct_description_sm: The Petite Riviere Water Quality Program has added this secondary complementary program to monitor water quality within the headwaters of Millipsigate Lake, Hebb Lake, and Minamkeak Lake, and within each of the lakes, to assess and mitigate harm to the environment and aquatic organisms within the watershed. This program is funded by the Habitat Stewardship Program.
dct_title_s: Petite Riviere Lakes and Headwaters Dataset
